title: Varanasi Heat Action Plan - Varanasi, India
organization: Varanasi Nagar Nigam, Department of Medical Health & Family Welfare, Mahila Housing Trust (MHT), NRDC India & Indian Institute of Public Health Gandhinagar (IIPHG) (VNN; MHT; NRDC; IIPH-G)
landscapes: Urban, Household, Institutional, Mass Gatherings, Occupational, Tropical and Subtropical
description: This municipal heat action plan for Varanasi uses localized climate analysis and ward-level heat vulnerability assessment to guide heat preparedness, early warning, inter-agency coordination, and public communication. It includes targeted measures for vulnerable residents, pilgrims and tourists, informal and outdoor workers, crowded ghats and transit points, schools, health facilities, water and power systems, and long-term urban heat mitigation such as cool roofs, greening, rainwater harvesting, and resilient planning.
